caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden bird, positioned in profile facing to the right. The bird is standing on a small, oval-shaped wooden base with a textured surface that suggests individual stones or a cobblestone pattern. The bird’s body, wings, and tail are detailed with carved patterns that mimic the natural texture of feathers. Its coloration is primarily shades of light to medium brown, with darker brown accents emphasizing the carved details and contours. The background is plain and off-white, making the wooden bird the central and only object in the composition. There are no additional elements or decorations surrounding the bird.
title: Pa. German Toy Hen
